correctness.rationale: The definitions and all-even quantifiers are explicit. Published Theorem 21 provides one-dimensional reduced-homology support and rank two; page-level inspection and finite exact chain checks support applicability. Edge-orbit classifications for rotation and its square are exhaustive and all listed orbit unions are genuine perfect or partial matchings. Orientation signs including the augmented empty face yield reduced Lefschetz traces zero and two. Degree parity and finite-order diagonalizability imply T^2=(-1)^d I; two congruence cases follow. Exact verifier program checks fixed simplices for n=4,6,8,10 and complete mod-two homology for n=4,6,8. This does not certify other coefficients or all n by experiment.

value.rationale: The precise top-homology action of the natural cyclic symmetry is a motivated invariant of the new Möbius-ladder perfect-matching-complex classification. The nonequivariant wedge leaves the representation undetermined. Showing uniformly bounded exact homological order two or four and the rational irreducible versus reducible dichotomy modulo four is a structural, all-even computation, not a routine restatement of homology ranks. Future equivariant treatments can use the character; no unproved downstream claim is needed.
